units.title: 四级选词：淀粉为何让酱汁变稠
units.instruction: Read the complete passage. Choose an unchanged word from the shared fifteen-word bank for each numbered gap. Each word may be used at most once; five words are not needed.

materials.title: A Sauce Changes in the Pan
materials.text:
In a cooking-science class, the tutor began with ____1____ starch powder that had not yet been cooked. Adding it directly to a hot liquid could produce ____2____, lumps with dry material trapped inside. Instead, the class first dispersed a measured amount in a little cool water.

The particles did not disappear as sugar would when fully dissolved. The technical term for this kind of mixture was a ____3____: solid particles spread through a liquid without becoming a true solution. The tiny ____4____ of starch remained present even when they were too small to see clearly as separate grains.

The liquid was ____5____ while the starch mixture was added. Moving a spoon through it helped distribute the material instead of leaving a concentrated patch at the bottom. Heat was increased ____6____, by stages rather than in one sudden change, according to the recipe being demonstrated.

As the conditions changed, the starch grains took in water and became ____7____. Their increased size was part of the change the class was discussing. The sauce ____8____, becoming less able to flow freely from the spoon. The tutor distinguished this from simply losing water through long boiling.

After a small sample had ____9____ to a lower temperature, its texture was checked again. The class did not assume that the hot sauce and the later serving would behave identically. They recorded how each sample had been prepared and when it was examined.

A successful result for this recipe was ____10____, with the material evenly distributed rather than some spoonfuls watery and others full of lumps. This did not establish that every starch or dish needed the same amounts and heating pattern. The exercise connected a visible cooking change with the behaviour of particles under stated conditions, allowing learners to explain more than whether the finished sauce looked appetising.

questions.prompt: A Sauce Changes in the Pan: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 1.
questions.explanation: not yet cooked限定raw生的。cooled表示曾温热后冷却，不等于未煮；opaque和transparent表光学性质，uniform均一都不说明未烹调状态。

questions.prompt: A Sauce Changes in the Pan: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 2.
questions.explanation: lumps dry material trapped inside定义clumps团块。granules是原有小颗粒，不是加热后干芯团，sediment为沉积层、suspension为整体分散体系，均非所述结块。

questions.prompt: A Sauce Changes in the Pan: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 3.
questions.explanation: solid particles dispersed not true solution定义suspension悬浮液。sediment指沉降物，granules单指颗粒、clumps团块不是整种混合状态；其他词无此技术名词义。

questions.prompt: A Sauce Changes in the Pan: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 4.
questions.explanation: tiny starch grains仍存在定义granules颗粒。clumps为大结块而非原始微小粒，sediment是沉积集合，suspension为体系非单个小粒；其他候选不合。

questions.prompt: A Sauce Changes in the Pan: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 5.
questions.explanation: Moving a spoon through it明说stirred搅拌。cooled是降温非勺子分散，separate原形不作was后被动，settle沉下与分布目的不同；其他词不表该动作。

questions.prompt: A Sauce Changes in the Pan: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 6.
questions.explanation: by stages rather sudden定义gradually逐渐。其他候选没有修饰increased的渐进方式副词；uniform是形容词，不可代替gradually表升热过程。

questions.prompt: A Sauce Changes in the Pan: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 7.
questions.explanation: took water increased size要求swollen膨胀的。opaque不透明、transparent透明、uniform均匀不说明粒子吸水变大；cooled表示温降而非尺寸。

questions.prompt: A Sauce Changes in the Pan: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 8.
questions.explanation: less able flow freely说明thickened变稠。settle为沉降、separate为分离，均非变稠，且给定原形不能填此过去叙述槽；其他词不作这里表示酱汁变稠的过去时谓语。

questions.prompt: A Sauce Changes in the Pan: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 9.
questions.explanation: to lower temperature定义cooled冷却。stirred只搅、swollen膨胀、raw生的均不说明样品后来温度降低，其他候选词形或义不合。

questions.prompt: A Sauce Changes in the Pan: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 10.
questions.explanation: evenly distributed rather watery/lumps说明uniform均一。opaque与transparent是可透光程度，不表每勺组成一致，raw生的不是分布；其他词不作此均匀性质形容词。

units.title: 四级选词：水盆与花盆之间的吸水绳

materials.title: The Cord Between Two Pots
materials.text:
A classroom plant experiment connected a water store to a pot with a strip of cloth. The separate water supply acted as a ____1____, a reserve from which water could be drawn. The cloth was ____2____, able to take liquid into its small spaces instead of simply shedding it from a smooth outer surface.

One end remained ____3____ in the water, below its surface. The other rested in the potting material. The tutor described ____4____ action, movement associated with water’s interaction with narrow spaces and the material around them. This helped explain why water could move through a suitable strip rather than remain only where the end touched the supply.

The strip could ____5____ water towards the pot, moving it between the two parts of the arrangement. The class checked the ____6____ of the potting material, how much water it contained, instead of judging supply by whether the cloth looked dark.

Water also ____7____ from exposed surfaces into the surrounding air. The reserve therefore decreased for more than one possible reason. A change in its level was not automatically the amount used by the plant alone.

A strip already ____8____ with water had its available spaces filled; it could not simply keep taking in unlimited additional liquid. For the system to work as intended, there also had to be a ____9____ connection, an unbroken path between supply and pot. A dry gap could interrupt movement.

The height arrangement mattered as well. ____10____ pulled water downwards, so changing the relative positions could change the result. The class followed the conditions of its particular test rather than treating every cloth, plant and height as equivalent. Records of water level and pot conditions helped learners describe the whole arrangement, not just assume that attaching a string guaranteed the right supply forever.

questions.prompt: The Cord Between Two Pots: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 1.
questions.explanation: reserve supply water定义reservoir储水源。humidity为空气湿度、moisture含水、gravity力不指备用水库；siphon为虹吸装置或过程，不是这里称作储水的部件角色。

questions.prompt: The Cord Between Two Pots: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 2.
questions.explanation: take liquid small spaces not shed定义absorbent吸水的。continuous连续、horizontal水平、vertical垂直、saturated已饱水均不表示材料吸入能力。

questions.prompt: The Cord Between Two Pots: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 3.
questions.explanation: below surface直接定义immersed浸没。saturated饱水指内部含水不等于端头位于水面下，其他候选不作remain后的该位置状态分词。

questions.prompt: The Cord Between Two Pots: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 4.
questions.explanation: narrow spaces material-water interactions明指定capillary毛细作用。siphon为虹吸名词不是此定语capillary action，gravity重力不能解释向细隙润湿关系；其他项不合。

questions.prompt: The Cord Between Two Pots: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 5.
questions.explanation: moving water between parts定义transfer转移。evaporates单数三人称不接could原形且是入空气，不以water作此宾语；其余候选无该原形输水动词。

questions.prompt: The Cord Between Two Pots: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 6.
questions.explanation: pot material how much water contains定义moisture含水量。humidity为空气水汽情况而非盆土中的水，reservoir供水源、gravity力均不是盆土水含量。

questions.prompt: The Cord Between Two Pots: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 7.
questions.explanation: water from surfaces into air定义evaporates蒸发。transfer原形需对象也不表示液入空气，其他候选非此单数主语一般现在相变动作。

questions.prompt: The Cord Between Two Pots: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 8.
questions.explanation: available spaces filled定义saturated饱和。immersed只位置在水下，不保证所用材料空间全满；absorbent是能力非已装满状态，其他词不合。

questions.prompt: The Cord Between Two Pots: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 9.
questions.explanation: unbroken path directly defines continuous连续。horizontal和vertical说明方向不保证不中断，absorbent吸水性也不保证全段相连；其他候选不表达无间隙连接。

questions.prompt: The Cord Between Two Pots: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 10.
questions.explanation: pulled water downwards直接指gravity重力。capillary在此可抗或伴移动但不等于向下重力，humidity湿度、siphon虹吸不是普遍向下拉力名；其他词不合。

units.instruction: Read the complete passage. Choose an unchanged word from the shared fifteen-word bank for each numbered gap. Each word may be used at most once; five words are not needed.

materials.title: The Rule on the Last Card
materials.text:
At a club’s trial of an original board game, players passed the starting role ____1____ around the table, following the direction of a clock’s hands. This did not mean that the same player always acted first. The role moved after each round under the stated rule.

The starting player had ____2____ when two actions competed for the same place: their claim would be considered before the others. The designer distinguished this from gaining extra points. Taking two ____3____ turns was also forbidden; a player could not act twice in immediate succession before another person had a chance.

To claim a harbour space, a player needed a matching card. Only a player holding that card was ____4____ for the action, allowed to take part under this condition. Everyone selected a card face down, and the choice was kept hidden until the same moment for all.

These were ____5____ choices, made for a shared reveal rather than shown one player after another. Once the cards were ____6____, visible to everyone, the group checked whether more than one person had claimed the same space.

Such a ____7____ between claims was settled by the starting-role rule. In a different optional version, a ____8____ draw would decide the result by chance instead. The designer labelled the versions separately so players did not unknowingly combine both tie-breaking methods.

After using a card, a player had to ____9____ it into the used pile rather than return it to the hand. The ____10____ of the unused cards stayed available for later rounds. The group tested these rules through an entire short game. A sentence that looked clear when read alone could still leave a question when several actions met, so the designer recorded the exact situation behind each request for clarification.

questions.prompt: The Rule on the Last Card: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 1.
questions.explanation: direction clock hands直接定义clockwise顺时针。adjacent为相邻、consecutive连续不表绕桌方向，random随机与固定钟向不同，其他项非该方向副词。

questions.prompt: The Rule on the Last Card: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 2.
questions.explanation: claim considered before others定义priority优先权。token是标记物而非先处理资格，exception例外、remainder剩余、conflict冲突不等于排序优势。

questions.prompt: The Rule on the Last Card: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 3.
questions.explanation: twice immediate succession直接定义consecutive连续的。simultaneous同时与先后连着不同，adjacent空间相邻，random随机均不等于两个紧接回合。

questions.prompt: The Rule on the Last Card: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 4.
questions.explanation: allowed under matching-card condition定义eligible有资格。random随机、simultaneous同时、adjacent相邻不表符合参与条件；其他词义或词性不符。

questions.prompt: The Rule on the Last Card: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 5.
questions.explanation: shared reveal rather one after another定义simultaneous同时的。consecutive逐一紧接与同时不同，clockwise方向、random随机不说明是否同一时刻揭示。

questions.prompt: The Rule on the Last Card: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 6.
questions.explanation: visible everyone对应revealed揭示。withdraw原形不适合were后且撤回非展示，inspect原形不是被动；其他候选无该揭牌过去分词。

questions.prompt: The Rule on the Last Card: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 7.
questions.explanation: more one claimed same space导致conflict冲突。priority是解争顺序而非冲突本身，exception例外、token物件、remainder剩余不指竞争同一格的情形。

questions.prompt: The Rule on the Last Card: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 8.
questions.explanation: by chance directly defines random随机。clockwise固定顺序、consecutive连续、simultaneous同时都不保证机会抽选；其他候选不作该机遇性质定语。

questions.prompt: The Rule on the Last Card: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 9.
questions.explanation: used pile rather return hand定义discard弃牌。withdraw可撤行为但不专指把用过卡放弃牌堆，inspect检查不移动到used pile，其他项非该原形动作。

questions.prompt: The Rule on the Last Card: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 10.
questions.explanation: unused cards stayed later说明remainder余下部分。token单标记、priority优先、conflict争端、exception例外都不是尚未用完牌集合。

units.title: 四级选词：照片缩略表中的选择记录
units.instruction: Read the complete passage. Choose an unchanged word from the shared fifteen-word bank for each numbered gap. Each word may be used at most once; five words are not needed.

materials.title: Small Pictures, Careful Choices
materials.text:
A student photographer reviewed a folder of images on a digital contact sheet. Each photograph first appeared as a ____1____, a small preview that could be opened at a larger size. This helped her inspect many files without loading a full-size view of each one immediately.

The images remained in their original ____2____, the order in which they had been taken. She could see how a person’s expression changed over several moments instead of treating every photograph as an isolated event. File names and capture times helped preserve that relationship.

A promising small preview did not settle the question of ____3____. When opened fully, the edges of an intended subject could prove blurred rather than crisp. The photographer also looked for a meaningful ____4____, such as the movement of a hand that connected the person to the action of the scene.

One image was ____5____ to remove a distracting area at the edge. The record kept the original file as well as the new version. Another was ____6____ for a large display, making weaknesses visible that had been difficult to notice in the small preview.

The photographer wrote a ____7____ describing the event shown, checking names and context instead of inventing an explanation from appearance alone. Some technically clear images were still ____8____ because they did not serve the purpose of the selection.

The files also recorded ____9____ information, the combined settings for admitting light during capture rather than the name of one mechanical part. This could help explain a result without deciding whether the picture was useful. Finally, the contact sheet displayed previews ____10____ at the same size, so a favourite was not made visually dominant simply by occupying more screen space. The sheet supported comparison; it did not make the editorial choice automatically.

questions.prompt: Small Pictures, Careful Choices: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 1.
questions.explanation: small clickable preview定义thumbnail缩略图。frame是一帧而非小预览功能，negative底片不是此数字显示，caption是文字，其他词不命名该界面元素。

questions.prompt: Small Pictures, Careful Choices: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 2.
questions.explanation: order taken定义sequence序列。exposure受光信息、gesture动作、sharpness清晰度、shutter快门都不指图像先后。

questions.prompt: Small Pictures, Careful Choices: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 3.
questions.explanation: edges blurred rather crisp解释sharpness锐度清晰。exposure是受光不直接等于边缘锐利，tonal为形容词、gesture动作、caption文字均非该可由大图检查的属性。

questions.prompt: Small Pictures, Careful Choices: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 4.
questions.explanation: movement hand connecting action定义gesture手势动作。frame图像单元、caption说明、sequence先后、shutter快门都不指画面人物的有意动作。

questions.prompt: Small Pictures, Careful Choices: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 5.
questions.explanation: remove area edge定义cropped裁剪。enlarged放大保留区域不等于移除，rejected弃选不产生新裁图，其他候选无该被动裁边义。

questions.prompt: Small Pictures, Careful Choices: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 6.
questions.explanation: large display及newly visible weaknesses表enlarged放大。cropped只是裁边而非为大显示增加呈现尺度，rejected未采用与display冲突；其他词不作该过去分词。

questions.prompt: Small Pictures, Careful Choices: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 7.
questions.explanation: describing event checking names context定义caption图说。sequence先后、frame影格、negative底片、gesture动作都非附图文字名词。

questions.prompt: Small Pictures, Careful Choices: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 8.
questions.explanation: did not serve selection purpose说明rejected剔除。enlarged放大、cropped裁剪是可选编辑动作不等于不采用，其他候选无被动弃选义。

questions.prompt: Small Pictures, Careful Choices: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 9.
questions.explanation: combined settings for admitting light定义exposure曝光信息。shutter是单个快门机构，不等于此处明确要求的整体受光设置；sharpness是边缘清晰、tonal是色调形容词，其他候选不命名这类拍摄参数。

questions.prompt: Small Pictures, Careful Choices: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 10.
questions.explanation: same size not dominant screen area定义uniformly一致地。vertical为垂直、tonal为色调形容词不能作此方式副词；其余候选无同等显示方式。

units.title: 六级选词：炭屑年代与土层形成时间
units.instruction: Read the complete passage. Choose an unchanged word from the shared fifteen-word bank for each numbered gap. Each word may be used at most once; five words are not needed.

materials.title: An Old Fragment in a Younger Layer
materials.text:
In a fictional archaeology seminar, students examined a charcoal fragment recovered from a sediment ____1____, a layer of material laid down at a site. Its position within the ____2____, the ordered sequence of layers, helped establish relationships with other finds. That position did not automatically make the fragment’s own age identical to the time the layer formed.

The fragment might have been ____3____ from an older location and carried into the newer layer. Material added during recovery or storage could also cause ____4____, introducing substances that interfered with interpretation of the sample. These were different questions about context and condition.

The dating exercise used a radioactive substance whose ____5____ proceeded according to a specified model. Its ____6____ was the period in which half of a starting amount would be expected to remain under that model. Students were given the necessary assumptions rather than asked to infer them from the fragment’s appearance.

The laboratory result then required ____7____ against an appropriate reference record before it could be expressed on the intended calendar scale. The reference relationship was part of the procedure, not a decorative adjustment added after the date had already become certain.

Repeated laboratory readings close to one another could indicate high ____8____. Their agreement did not guarantee that the material dated the archaeological event the student wanted to identify. The report retained ____9____ about the result and its interpretation instead of turning a measured value into a perfectly known moment.

The charcoal could also possess an ____10____ age: it might derive from old wood already years old before burning. A date connected with that material was therefore not automatically the date of the fire or the deposition. The exercise separated sample history, laboratory procedure and the historical question, so confidence in one part did not silently settle the others.

questions.prompt: An Old Fragment in a Younger Layer: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 1.
questions.explanation: layer material laid down定义deposit沉积层。erosion是侵蚀移除而非堆积层，stratigraphy是层序研究或序列而非此a layer单层，interval间隔不是沉积物。

questions.prompt: An Old Fragment in a Younger Layer: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 2.
questions.explanation: ordered sequence layers定义stratigraphy地层序。deposit单层、calibration校准、measurement测量、interval间隔均不指层叠关系整体。

questions.prompt: An Old Fragment in a Younger Layer: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 3.
questions.explanation: older location carried newer layer定义reworked再搬运的。inherited为材料原有年龄而非明确从旧地点搬入新层，uniformly副词不能作此过去分词，其他候选无该再沉积动作。

questions.prompt: An Old Fragment in a Younger Layer: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 4.
questions.explanation: introduced substances interfere sample定义contamination污染。erosion侵蚀不同于回收储存添入异物，decay衰变为原物过程，calibration校准不是外质加入。

questions.prompt: An Old Fragment in a Younger Layer: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 5.
questions.explanation: radioactive substance process specified model指decay衰变。erosion是环境移除、contamination混入、measurement观察读数均非同位素自发变化过程。

questions.prompt: An Old Fragment in a Younger Layer: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 6.
questions.explanation: period half starting amount remain明确定义half-life半衰期。interval泛时间隔不特定剩半、precision精密度、uncertainty不确定性不表示该物理期限。

questions.prompt: An Old Fragment in a Younger Layer: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 7.
questions.explanation: against reference record calendar scale定义calibration校准。measurement只测读不保证对照转换，validate是动词不接required后的此过程名，其他名词不表该参考标定。

questions.prompt: An Old Fragment in a Younger Layer: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 8.
questions.explanation: repeated readings close together定义precision精密度。measurement为测量本身不指重复一致性，uncertainty是未知范围而非high后此一致特征，calibration为过程不是重复接近程度。

questions.prompt: An Old Fragment in a Younger Layer: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 9.
questions.explanation: instead perfectly known moment表保留uncertainty不确定性。precision可重复一致但不能表达尚未知边界，half-life物理周期、interval泛时段不能替代认识状态。

questions.prompt: An Old Fragment in a Younger Layer: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 10.
questions.explanation: old wood already aged before burning说明inherited继承的材料年龄。reworked是搬运事件不必老木燃前龄，uniformly副词、其他名词不能作an后age的该性质定语。

units.title: 六级选词：密封出价模型中的价值与支付
units.instruction: Read the complete passage. Choose an unchanged word from the shared fifteen-word bank for each numbered gap. Each word may be used at most once; five words are not needed.

materials.title: The Number Written in the Envelope
materials.text:
A fictional economics class analysed a simplified auction for one object. Each participant had a private ____1____, the value they assigned to receiving it. For the exercise, those values were fixed and participants cared about the difference between value and payment under the stated rules.

Offers were ____2____ inside envelopes until the deadline, hidden from competing participants. The number written by a participant was a ____3____, which did not have to equal the value held privately. The highest valid offer identified the ____4____, the person allocated the object.

The seller also announced a ____5____ price, a minimum below which the object would not be sold. The class kept this rule separate from the amount offered by each participant. An apparent highest offer could still fail the minimum condition.

The model assumed participants acted ____6____ rather than coordinating their offers. ____7____, an agreement among them to manipulate the competition, would violate that assumption. A conclusion obtained under independent behaviour could not simply be carried into that different setting.

Under the version being examined, the successful participant paid an amount determined by the highest acceptable competing offer rather than their own larger offer, subject to the announced minimum. The tutor asked how this changed the ____8____ to report a private value, the motivation created by the payment rule.

A ____9____ report would state that value honestly. The class compared outcomes under the model’s assumptions rather than treating the rule as advice for every real market. It distinguished the offer from the price finally paid, and the resulting ____10____ from seller revenue: the successful participant’s value minus payment was not the money received by the seller.

The exercise’s lesson was to identify values, actions and payment rules before drawing a behavioural conclusion. Similar-looking envelopes could belong to mechanisms with importantly different consequences.

questions.prompt: The Number Written in the Envelope: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 1.
questions.explanation: value assigned receiving object定义valuation估值。bid是实际报数未必同值，allocation分配、surplus价值减支付、reserve底价都不是私人价值本身。

questions.prompt: The Number Written in the Envelope: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 2.
questions.explanation: inside envelopes hidden deadline要求sealed密封。strategic策略性不等于封存，truthful诚实不等于别人看不见，dominant占优也非信封状态，其他词不作offers were后的该分词。

questions.prompt: The Number Written in the Envelope: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 3.
questions.explanation: number written offer定义bid出价。valuation内心价值可不同，reserve卖家门槛，surplus剩余、incentive动机都非提交的报价。

questions.prompt: The Number Written in the Envelope: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 4.
questions.explanation: highest valid offer person allocated定义winner中标者。allocation是行为而非人，其他候选不命名最高有效报价取得物件的参与者。

questions.prompt: The Number Written in the Envelope: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 5.
questions.explanation: minimum seller acceptable price定义reserve保留价。bid为买家报价非卖方门槛，valuation私人估值不等于最低售值；其余候选无该固定词组reserve price的义。

questions.prompt: The Number Written in the Envelope: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 6.
questions.explanation: rather coordinating offers明确independently独立地。其他候选无表独立行为方式副词，strategic形容词不能代替这里的acted方式副词。

questions.prompt: The Number Written in the Envelope: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 7.
questions.explanation: agreement manipulate competition定义collusion合谋。allocation分配、incentive动机、uncertainty不确定性、surplus剩余都不指参与者串通协议。

questions.prompt: The Number Written in the Envelope: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 8.

questions.prompt: The Number Written in the Envelope: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 9.
questions.explanation: report value honestly直接定义truthful诚实的。strategic策略性不保证报真值，dominant占优是策略比较属性不等同诚实报告，sealed封闭不说明真伪。

questions.prompt: The Number Written in the Envelope: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 10.
questions.explanation: value minus payment直接定义surplus剩余收益。seller revenue是收款而非买家价值差，valuation未减付、bid是报价、reserve底价都不等于该差额。

units.title: 六级选词：词典义项与实际用例
units.instruction: Read the complete passage. Choose an unchanged word from the shared fifteen-word bank for each numbered gap. Each word may be used at most once; five words are not needed.

materials.title: A Word Enters the Dictionary
materials.text:
At a fictional dictionary project, editors searched a ____1____, a collection of language examples assembled for systematic study. An expression reported from memory was treated differently from one ____2____ in a dated text, actually evidenced in the material the editors could inspect.

For a promising example, staff kept a ____3____ recording the relevant words and their source. This gave a later editor a route back to the evidence rather than merely a claim that someone had once seen the expression. The dictionary entry’s main printed label was its ____4____, under which related information would be arranged.

Several examples could support a particular ____5____, one meaning of the word in context. Finding the same spelling did not guarantee that every passage used it in the same way. Editors compared what the surrounding language allowed, rather than join unrelated meanings because the letters matched.

Labels also needed evidence. The ____6____ of an expression concerned its level and style, such as a formal or conversational use. A ____7____ label indicated association with a geographical variety. Neither judgement was made solely from the identity of one person who happened to have used the word.

A word marked ____8____ was no longer in ordinary current use according to the entry’s stated evidence and policy. That did not mean it had become meaningless in a historical text. The editors distinguished a reader’s need to interpret an older source from a claim that the expression remained common today.

A different spelling might be listed as a ____9____ rather than treated as a separate unrelated word. The project described the relationship supported by the examples. Its notes about ____10____ concerned how people actually used expressions, with dates and limits, rather than simply announcing which form the editor personally preferred.

The completed entry was a concise account built from selected evidence. It remained open to revision when additional examples changed the picture, and it did not confuse absence from this particular collection with proof that no speaker had ever used a form.

questions.prompt: A Word Enters the Dictionary: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 1.
questions.explanation: collection language examples systematic study直接定义corpus语料库。citation单条引证、headword条目词头、usage用法不是整套研究集合；currency指通行性非材料集合。

questions.prompt: A Word Enters the Dictionary: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 2.
questions.explanation: dated text actually evidenced定义attested有文证。speculative为推测与可核文本相反，verbatim为逐字并不表示存在证据的词形，其他候选不作one后的该分词。

questions.prompt: A Word Enters the Dictionary: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 3.
questions.explanation: record words source、route back evidence定义citation引证。corpus整个集合、headword词头、variant异体、sense义项都不是带来源的单条证据记录。

questions.prompt: A Word Enters the Dictionary: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 4.
questions.explanation: entry main printed label直接定义headword词头。citation引证、sense词义、register语体、variant异形不等于条目主标。

questions.prompt: A Word Enters the Dictionary: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 5.
questions.explanation: one meaning in context直接定义sense义项。headword是词形标题，usage广泛用法、register语体层次、citation实例均非这里特定语义。

questions.prompt: A Word Enters the Dictionary: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 6.
questions.explanation: level style formal conversational定义register语域。currency通行性、regional地域属性、usage总用法不专指此风格层级；其他候选不合。

questions.prompt: A Word Enters the Dictionary: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 7.
questions.explanation: geographical variety定义regional区域性。idiomatic为惯用、transitive及物、obsolete过时、speculative推测均不表示地域关联。

questions.prompt: A Word Enters the Dictionary: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 8.
questions.explanation: no longer ordinary current use定义obsolete废弃过时。regional地区限定不等于不再用，idiomatic惯用反不说明时间退出，transitive句法属性、speculative猜测均非时态地位。

questions.prompt: A Word Enters the Dictionary: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 9.
questions.explanation: different spelling related rather unrelated说明variant异体。sense不同意义未必异拼，headword主词头不等于附列异形，citation用例不是拼写关系类别。

questions.prompt: A Word Enters the Dictionary: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 10.
questions.explanation: how people actually used expressions定义usage用法。currency只是流行通用程度，register语体、citation实例、corpus集合都不能完整代替该实际使用情况总类。

units.title: 六级选词：产品批次召回中的追溯链
units.instruction: Read the complete passage. Choose an unchanged word from the shared fifteen-word bank for each numbered gap. Each word may be used at most once; five words are not needed.

materials.title: Which Boxes Need to Come Back?
materials.text:
In a fictional quality-control exercise, a factory discovered a fault associated with one production ____1____, a group made under a recorded set of conditions. The affected goods had not all travelled together. Some were still in the store and others had been sent to several customers.

The records provided ____2____, the ability to follow the goods from production through later movements. A shipment number alone was insufficient because one delivery could combine material from several production groups. Conversely, one group could be divided among many deliveries.

Items judged ____3____ failed the relevant specification. The response included a ____4____, an organised request for affected products to be returned or otherwise handled under the announced procedure. The exercise did not assume that every product made by the factory had the same fault.

Goods still on site were ____5____ from usable stock so they would not be sent out while the investigation continued. Staff checked the ____6____, the recorded quantities held, against what was physically present. An entry saying that boxes existed was not a substitute for locating the right boxes.

The ____7____ records showed how products had moved through sellers and receiving organisations. Staff identified which affected boxes had already been ____8____, sent away from the factory, and contacted the appropriate recipients through the designated process.

A plan for ____9____ specified which units would be examined rather than allowing inspectors to choose only the easiest examples. The results could inform the investigation within the plan’s limits, not certify every unexamined object automatically.

Finally, staff had to ____10____ the different records, checking and resolving discrepancies between production totals, stored quantities and outward movements. The exercise ended with a documented account of what had been identified, recovered and left uncertain. A clear boundary around the affected group depended on linked evidence, not merely a confident announcement that the problem had been contained.

questions.prompt: Which Boxes Need to Come Back?: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 1.
questions.explanation: group made recorded production conditions定义batch生产批。consignment按同次运送分的货批，文中明确一生产批可多配送且一配送可多批，不能互换；inventory库存总账非生产单元。

questions.prompt: Which Boxes Need to Come Back?: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 2.
questions.explanation: ability follow production later movements定义traceability可追溯性。distribution是分销动作网络、inventory持有量、yield产出量不直接等于追踪能力。

questions.prompt: Which Boxes Need to Come Back?: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 3.
questions.explanation: failed relevant specification定义defective有缺陷。sealed封装不等于不合规格，isolated被隔离是处置不是缺陷性质，upstream上游不评合格，其他候选不合。

questions.prompt: Which Boxes Need to Come Back?: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 4.
questions.explanation: organised request return affected goods定义recall召回。consignment运货、sampling抽检、distribution分销、expiry到期都不是通知回收的响应。

questions.prompt: Which Boxes Need to Come Back?: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 5.
questions.explanation: from usable stock to prevent sent说明isolated隔离。sealed封严未必从正常库分开，dispatched反而已寄出，与still on site待查矛盾；其他词不表该处理。

questions.prompt: Which Boxes Need to Come Back?: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 6.
questions.explanation: recorded quantities held定义inventory库存账。distribution移动记录不是当下所存总量，yield生产产出不等于仍持有，batch单批、consignment单货运不是全库存记录。

questions.prompt: Which Boxes Need to Come Back?: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 7.
questions.explanation: moved through sellers receiving organisations定义distribution分销流向。expiry到期、sampling抽样、yield产量不指下游流转记录；inventory静态持有不同。

questions.prompt: Which Boxes Need to Come Back?: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 8.
questions.explanation: sent away factory直接定义dispatched发运。isolated隔离未外发，sealed密封未必已寄，defective缺陷性质不说明出库；其他词词性不合。

questions.prompt: Which Boxes Need to Come Back?: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 9.
questions.explanation: which units examined rather easiest定义sampling抽样。recall为召回，distribution分销、inventory库存、expiry到期均不指挑哪些单元检验的设计。

questions.prompt: Which Boxes Need to Come Back?: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 10.
questions.explanation: checking resolving discrepancies records定义reconcile核对调和。yield为产生不以different records为此核差宾语，其他候选非to后的该原形动作。
